channel.title: The Constitution of God — Journal
channel.description: Essays from Mark H Steffen on The Constitution of God.

item.title: How to Read These Fourteen Chapters with a Group
item.description: Use the paths the book already has. One chapter a week if you mean to finish. Four questions that keep the hour on the argument.

item.title: Heaven, America, and One Vocabulary
item.description: The last four chapters name a nation inside a creation. The right word for that meeting is echo, and an echo is not an identity.

item.title: Why the Manuscript Turns on a Second Adam
item.description: Chapter 6 is the hinge. Restoration in this table of contents is not a mood. It is a line of persons, and it is unfinished.

item.title: What “Divine Constitutional Order” Means in This Book
item.description: The manuscript does not open in 1787. It opens with a claim about God, and the later civic chapters are sequels to that claim.
